description:
Get the cached PDF-extractions for several BSE filings of ONE company in one call. Accepts
    NSE symbol, ISIN, or BSE code + a list of up to 10 BSE news_ids (from get_stock_events).

    Use this instead of calling get_filing_extract once per filing. Each entry in `filings` (in
    request order) is exactly what get_filing_extract returns for that filing: extracted facts
    with verbatim source quotes when cached, otherwise `pending` / `not_queued` / `failed` with
    the same `reason_code` values. Every uncached filing with a PDF is ENQUEUED for on-demand
    extraction in this one call (each enqueue counts against the caller's per-day on-demand cap;
    once the cap is reached the rest return `not_queued` reason `on_demand_quota_exceeded`).
    This tool never waits. When some filings are still `pending`, the response lists them in
    `pending_news_ids` with one shared `retry_after_seconds`: call this tool again after that
    long with just `pending_news_ids`. `counts` tallies the entries by status. To keep the
    response small, a cached filing past the size budget comes back as a stub listed in
    `omitted_for_size`; fetch it with get_filing_extract (it is cached, so no new extraction). A
    news_id that is not this company's filing returns `status="request_error"` without failing
    the batch. Raw disclosed facts with verbatim source quotes only — no verdicts, targets, or
    recommendations.
name: get_filing_extracts
